title: chai-trigger comment payload
description: The JSON a redhat-chai-bot comment carries (after the hidden marker line, inside a fenced json block) to start the Auto Rebase and/or the CVE scan. The executable form of this contract is validate-payload.sh, which the workflow runs; this file is the declarative form chai references.

branches.description: Exactly one release branch per trigger. The allowed values are the workflows' boolean inputs minus unsupported streams (oadp-1.4 .. oadp-1.6, oadp-dev; oadp-1.3 left support 2026-10-31); this schema cannot enumerate them because GitHub input definitions are static per workflow file -- validate-payload.sh takes the allowed list as an argument.

dry_run.description: true reports and previews only; false lets the workflows open real pull requests, which a person reviews and merges.

timeout_minutes.description: Optional wait budget for the rebase-before-scan gate.

plan_id.description: chai's plan identifier, carried so an unknown post outcome can be recovered by finding this plan's comment.
